name: Summer 2025 Monsoon and La Niña Flooding Event
location: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP), Western Punjab, Sindh (specifically Kashmore, Ghotki, Sukkur, Shikarpur, Khairpur, Dadu, Naushero Feroz, Jamshoro, Larkana, Shaheed Benazirabad)
impact: Widespread inundation affecting 2.2 million people in the exposure zone due to heavy monsoon rainfall, glacial melt, and Western Disturbances.
context: Climatic factors including La Niña, positive IOD, elevated Tibetan Plateau temperatures, and active Western Disturbance are converging to intensify monsoon rainfall and cause heavy precipitation in western river catchments and hill torrents.

phases.d_day: Day 0 - Initial Warning and Onset of Heavy Rains
phases.d1_to_d5: Days 1-5 - Peak Flooding and Immediate Evacuation
phases.d20_to_d50: Days 20-50 - Long-term Rehabilitation and Infrastructure Repair
